sources.fullCitation: Gana, Jacques. “POTHIER (Charles-Louis).” Encyclopédie multimédia de la comédie musicale théâtrale en France. Gives the dates Bordeaux, 18 April 1881 – Noyers-sur-Serein (Yonne), 3 November 1962, and describes Pothier as co-librettist with René Pujol under Albert Willemetz at the Bouffes-Parisiens from 1928. Accessed 1 August 2026.
